subject: test(multiple): remove unnecessary fakeAsync and add flush
decision: Decline the upstream fakeAsync/flush fixture rewrite after individual review of all 24 complete files and 285 hunks. A finite original source projection accounts for every import, inline fakeAsync wrapper, zero-argument clock drain, explicit render mark and case-name record. The tooltip spy/position reorder is individually recorded as an observation change. All remaining source operations are equal, with every raw normalization node/context and complete case/hook/helper/template frame pinned. This proves source applicability only, not real/fake-clock equivalence. Keep all historical callbacks, temporal/lifecycle/error assertions and Material16 HTML/CSS/SCSS; no product/consumer API changes are required. Read-only Cyph sanity confirms existing legacy module/markup/style bindings; no consumer edit. Actual packed/native/browser/SSR/compiler/Node/RxJS/exact-peer floors and independent audit remain required.
